[University: HABIB University | Category: hostel] Accommodation for Out of Karachi Students Habib University is cognizant of the fact that outstation students who have been offered admission may require accommodation in Karachi. Being a non-residential campus, Habib University strongly encourages all outstation students to make arrangements for their accommodation well in advance to avoid any inconvenience during studies. Our current students fromoutside of Karachi either stay with their relatives or have acquired a place in the hostels available in Karachi. You may look into areas closer to the university, such as Gulistan-e-Jauhar, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, KDA, and PECHS, when exploring your accommodation options. Availability of accommodation closer to campus will allow for a shorter and more convenient commute, making it easier for you to attend classes, participate in campus activities, and manage your daily schedule more comfortably. Disclaimer: We understand that safety and security are significant concerns when it comes to seeking accommodation.
